final: WITH per_order AS (SELECT orderslink, AVG(rebtotal) AS avg_total_rebate, AVG(rebrate / feerate) AS avg_ratio FROM fees WHERE rebrate > 0.0005 GROUP BY orderslink), ranked AS (SELECT orderslink, avg_total_rebate, avg_ratio, avg_ratio / AVG(avg_ratio) OVER () AS relative_ratio FROM per_order) SELECT orderslink, avg_total_rebate, avg_ratio, relative_ratio FROM ranked ORDER BY relative_ratio DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
